translations.title: Tricky Addon translations
translations.guide:
The Tricky Store manager uses Tricky Addon's translations. Improve them on [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/TA_utl); *Update translations* brings the latest ones here without a module update.

Everything else is translated in Duck ToolBox's `locales/*.json` files. Open a pull request on [GitHub]({repository}) to add or fix a language.

help.modesDescription: Long-press a selected app (or tap its tune button) to force certificate generating (`!`) or leaf hack (`?`) for it, or to give it its own policy. Only Tricky Store supports this.
help.backendsDescription: Tricky Store (config.ini and legacy target.txt), TEESimulator (config.json) and OhMyKeymint (injector.toml and config.toml). Duck ToolBox writes the active module's own format.

errors.backend_rule: Rejected by the keystore module's rules

ta.help_select_denylist_description: Available in Magisk only, select apps that are in the DenyList. Recommended.
ta.help_deselect_unnecessary_description: **Unnecessary category** - Xposed module, root manager, root-related apps, and general apps that never check bootloader status. This option requires Internet connection.
ta.help_add_system_app_description: Add specific system app to app list.
ta.help_set_keybox_aosp: **AOSP** - the default keybox comes with TrickyStore.
ta.help_set_keybox_unknown: **Unknown** - self-signed and not valid for Play Integrity verdict.
ta.help_set_keybox_custom: **Custom** - custom keybox provider via online fetching.
ta.help_set_default_policy_description: Formerly `Set Security Patch`. Config default policy for all targeted apps, Leave blank or `no` to disable, `prop` to keep consist with system prop.
ta.help_prop_settings_boot_hash: **Boot hash** - get `verifiedBootHash` value from [KeyAttestation](https://github.com/vvb2060/KeyAttestation/releases). Fix abnormal boot state by resetting `ro.boot.vbmeta.digest`.
ta.about_disclaimer: This module is not a part of the Tricky Store module. DO NOT report any issues to Tricky Store if encountered.

ta.prompt_no_update: There are currently no updates available
